svg.title: Check a tap before and after time runs out
svg.desc: Signal Sprint has a target, a score and a 15-second clock. The same tap can have a different result after time runs out. Wrong target. Tap a different symbol. The score and current target should stay the same. Right target. Tap the matching symbol. Check the new score and the next target. Time is up. Let the clock reach zero, then try the target. The finished score should stay put.
svg.text: Check a tap before and after time runs out
Signal Sprint has a target, a score and a 15-second clock. The same tap can
have a different result after time runs out.
Tap a different symbol. The score and current target should stay the same.
Tap the matching symbol. Check the new score and the next target.
Let the clock reach zero, then try the target. The finished score should stay put.
